description: NaTl₃F₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-like structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent F¹⁻ atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TlF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent TlF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.21 Å. There are two inequivalent Tl¹ᐧ⁶⁷⁺ sites. In the first Tl¹ᐧ⁶⁷⁺ site, Tl¹ᐧ⁶⁷⁺ is bonded to twelve equivalent F¹⁻ atoms to form TlF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent TlF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent TlF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent TlF₆ octahedra. All Tl-F bond lengths are 3.09 Å. In the second Tl¹ᐧ⁶⁷⁺ site, Tl¹ᐧ⁶⁷⁺ is bonded to six equivalent F¹⁻ atoms to form TlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent TlF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Tl-F bond lengths are 2.16 Å. F¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na¹⁺ and five Tl¹ᐧ⁶⁷⁺ atoms.
